Line Rider track converter

Upload a Line Rider track or paste a Scratch save code. Copy the result into Track > Load track code in the Scratch project.

Line Rider .track.json, including compressed line arrays, or a text file containing an LR1 code. Files stay in your browser.

Reversed collision sides and endpoint extensions need changes. The converter will list them before you copy.

Choose a file or paste a code to begin.

    Supported formats and limits

    Normal lines stay normal. Acceleration lines keep their boost direction. Scenery stays scenery. Scratch Grip and Ice materials are preserved in LR1 codes. Official JSON imports have no goal flag, so the ride will not end early.

    Scratch supports 3,000 segments and coordinates within +/-1,000,000. Coordinates are rounded to hundredths. Binary .trk, Flash .sol, music, scripts, layers and custom physics are not imported. Tracks may ride differently in Scratch.

    In linerider.com, export your track as .track.json. In Scratch, use Track > Save track code to get an LR1 code.
